The complete site as static files: HTML, JS, CSS, fonts and the event corpus. Unzip it onto any static host (or run `npx serve .` inside the folder) and it works as-is. There is no server, no analytics and no network call at runtime.

Suggested host configuration (headers and caching) is in `docs/DEPLOYMENT.md`.

- 224 events across thirteen eras, 82 misconception callouts, seven tours
- 72 regions with per-event control deltas, verified at twelve checkpoint years
- Desktop and mobile layouts
